judge_panel.matching_evidence:
[mathematical] In Section IV.C, Equation (2) incorrectly formulates flow conservation for a multi-hop network. The constraint $\sum_j f_{ij} = d_i z_i$ strictly limits the total outgoing flow from a Connected and Automated Vehicle (CAV) $i$ to its own injected demand $d_i$. It entirely omits the incoming flow from other nodes ($\sum_k f_{ki}$) that CAV $i$ is supposed to relay.
Concrete fix: Update Equation (2) to standard flow conservation to account for both generated and relayed traffic: $\sum_{j} f_{ij} - \sum_{k} f_{ki} = d_i z_i \quad \forall i \in \text{CAV}$.
judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer precisely identifies the deleted incoming-flow term and provides the original corrected equation, which directly corresponds to the injected mathematical error.
